flow.name: order-support-get-order-flow
flow.doc:name: Get Order Flow
flow.doc:description: Handles GET /api/orders/{orderId}: looks up the demo order and enriches it with the live Stripe payment

http:listener.doc:name: GET /api/orders/{orderId}
http:listener.doc:description: Receives inbound HTTP GET requests for a single order by orderId path parameter

set-variable.doc:name: Set orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts the orderId path parameter into a flow variable

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint with the requested orderId
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Order lookup started', tracePoint: 'START'} ++ ({ orderId: vars.orderId })]

ee:transform.doc:name: Lookup order
ee:transform.doc:description: Looks up the order by orderId in the in-memory demo catalogue

choice.doc:name: Order found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to a 404 response when the order is unknown, otherwise enriches it with Stripe

when.doc:name: Not found
when.doc:description: Handles the case where no order matches the requested orderId

set-variable.doc:name: Set 404
set-variable.doc:description: Sets the HTTP status variable to 404 for the not-found response

ee:transform.doc:name: Not found response
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the ORDER_NOT_FOUND JSON error body for the unknown orderId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "ORDER_NOT_FOUND", message: "Order " ++ vars.orderId ++ " not found" }

logger.doc:name: Order not found
logger.doc:description: Logs a FLOW-level warning that the requested order was not found

otherwise.doc:name: Order found
otherwise.doc:description: Enriches the found order with its live Stripe payment status

set-variable.doc:name: Set order
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the matched order in a flow variable for downstream enrichment

logger.doc:name: Before Stripe call - INFO
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST as the flow is about to fetch the Stripe PaymentIntent
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Fetching payment from Stripe for order ' ++ vars.orderId, tracePoint: 'BEFORE_REQUEST'}]

logger.doc:name: Before Stripe call - DEBUG
logger.doc:description: Logs the PaymentIntent id being requested from Stripe (DEBUG)
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Stripe PaymentIntent request', tracePoint: 'BEFORE_REQUEST'} ++ ({ paymentIntentId: vars.order.paymentIntentId })]

http:request.doc:name: Get Stripe payment
http:request.doc:description: Fetches the PaymentIntent from Stripe with the latest charge expanded, so the refund state can be read

logger.doc:name: After Stripe call - INFO
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once Stripe has returned the PaymentIntent
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Stripe responded for order ' ++ vars.orderId, tracePoint: 'AFTER_REQUEST'}]

logger.doc:name: After Stripe call - DEBUG
logger.doc:description: Logs the Stripe payment status and amount returned for the order (DEBUG)

ee:transform.doc:name: Build order response
ee:transform.doc:description: Combines the order and Stripe payment into the final JSON response with refund status

logger.doc:name: Flow end
logger.doc:description: Logs END tracePoint with the orderId and resolved HTTP status
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Order lookup completed', tracePoint: 'END'} ++ ({ orderId: vars.orderId, httpStatus: vars.httpStatus default 200 })]

logger.doc:name: Log API error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description on any failure

set-variable.doc:name: Set 500
set-variable.doc:description: Sets the HTTP status variable to 500 for the error response

ee:transform.doc:name: Error response
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the INTERNAL_ERROR JSON body returned to the caller on failure

flow.name: order-support-health-flow
flow.doc:name: Health Flow
flow.doc:description: Handles GET /api/health used by the gateway and the policy demo for liveness checks

http:listener.doc:name: GET /api/health
http:listener.doc:description: Receives inbound HTTP GET health-check requests on /api/health

ee:transform.doc:name: Health response
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the UP status JSON payload with app name and current timestamp

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "UP", app: "demo-order-support-api", timestamp: now() }
